# A stand-in for the privacy notice, for the tests only (Phase 161e, 5 November 2026)

This is NOT Cap Rebate's privacy notice. The real one is kept in OneDrive only, not in git, so on a fresh copy of the
project the notices page's tests point the acceptance check (03-app/caprebate-notices-acceptance.cjs, --privacy) at
this file instead. It holds only what that check reads: the notices page's address, the data protection mailbox, and
two processors the notices page already names in public. On the Mac's OneDrive copy the tests read the real notice.

Our public notices are at https://caprebate.co.uk/notices/ and you can write to data.protection@caprebate.co.uk.

# Section 6 Who else sees it

## Processors

- **Vercel**, which hosts our test website.
- **Turso**, the database behind our test website.
